lines: To translate our commitment to diversity into tangible outcomes, the University implements
1. Students: All students are treated with care and respect, ensuring their full inclusion, and
addressing their specific circumstances. Students are expected to respect the cultural
heritage of the institution and the wider Emirati society, fostering common spaces for
2. Faculty: Faculty members are fully incorporated into the University’s structures and
systems based on their abilities and contributions. They are treated with care and respect,
with channels available to express diversity and inclusion-related concerns. Faculty are
expected to be sensitive to students’ differences and deliver teaching that accommodates
diverse backgrounds. Their research should align with ethical criteria, promoting
accessibility and representation of all groups when appropriate.
3. Staff: All staff members receive support and care, regardless of their backgrounds. The
recruitment and assessment processes are transparent and equitable, recognizing the
contributions of each individual. Staff are expected to treat colleagues and students with
care and respect, fostering diversity and inclusion throughout the organization.
The University of Sharjah is committed to diversity, inclusion, and cohabitation among students,
faculty, and staff. We celebrate multiculturalism, gender balance, and diverse socio-economic
backgrounds. Our efforts aim to foster innovation and creativity, creating a space where
individuals are embraced for their backgrounds. We continue to enhance and uphold our tradition
of diversity as a source of strength and resilience in the University of Sharjah.
